dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: The winds will inevitably sweep the dust and sands aside, but from what may we find the power to invoke the presence of wind itself...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wind?

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Hmm... To regard an outlander such as you...

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Never mind. Cast it from your thoughts. Mellifluous though the voice of the canary may be, how, yet, can a mere melodious voice rupture the webs of affection.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you around.

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Farewell, stranger... May your path be barren of sandstorms.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't understand what you're trying to say...

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Then, stranger, perhaps you should regard my words as but passing wind.

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: "Flap flap flap," and the little canary returns! Hehe! Congratulations!

response.speaker: Masseira
response.text: Look at you! Look. At. You. The little canary got the poisonous scorpion all tied around itself without even knowing what happened... Amazing! Truly amazing!

response.speaker: Masseira
response.text: But... that little wildcat, like you, is so very ignorant of the great net she has found herself in, relying only on intuition and instinct to struggle and strain...

response.speaker: Masseira
response.text: "Ripping, tearing..." Will she sink deeper, I wonder?

response.speaker: Masseira
response.text: Oh, oh! I have aroused your anger, I see!

response.speaker: Masseira
response.text: Haha. It is nothing... Please, take care of her, for she is a good child.

response.speaker: Masseira
response.text: Oh, and are you a little falcon, then? Hah, but you must overcome my falcon first for that to be the case!

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Spoken to Babel, have you? Ah, she's probably busying herself somewhere else again... You would sooner stop the wind than stop her.

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Haha... You know, youngster, speaking of the wind... I'd like to remind you of a kind of desert wind that we call "Zibri."

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: At first, you won't sense anything, until the sandstorm rises over the horizon, and the air itself begins to ascend and burn. Only then will you realize...

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: ...That you can no longer smell anything, for the heated air has smothered your sense of smell, seared your nostrils...

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: By then... Heh. By then, it will be too late.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm afraid I didn't catch your drift...

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: It's nothing... I just mean to say that you should be careful of the sandstorms.

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Hehe, so it's you... Youngster, I have heard that you and Jeht went into the accursed city. Ah, and you would like to know how I know this, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Hunters have falcons and hounds to be their eyes and ears, naturally. But young one, I must remind you that this word, the "curse," comes not out of thin air.

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: A venom, the root of all tragedy, that drives all humans add, is hidden within a facade of flowing gold.

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Perhaps it shall be so this time as well, that greedy prey shall fall into a trap, where they cannot be saved...

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Oh, if it isn't our esteemed guest...

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Color me impressed! What you did was a feat for the ages.

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Perhaps one day, should I ask for your help, I hope that you'll still be willing to offer it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll give you a hand when the time comes.

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Then I thank you in advance.

choices.text: Sure, but shall we play a round of cards first?

response.speaker: Masseira
response.text: Cards? With you? It will be my pleasure.

choices.text: I'll give you a hand when the time comes.
